# Offline capture fixtures

`sample.pcap` and `sample.pcapng` contain the same nine inert packets, generated by
`scripts/generate_capture.py` without opening a network socket. They cover a DNS
query/response, a bidirectional TCP flow with a TLS ClientHello, HTTP request/response,
and unrelated UDP traffic. Documentation address ranges are intentional.

Tests invoke the real installed `tshark`. These synthetic captures verify format and
protocol compatibility; they are not evidence of validation against a real incident.
